note: Both sets hallucinate a linear-stiffness value of 7,000 N·m/rad which is not in the source text (actual value is 867,637,000). Set B contains an additional factual error by claiming the natural frequency is 5% critical, whereas the text states the structural-damping ratio is 5% critical; Set A correctly binds the 5% to the damping ratio. Although Set A is noisier with many duplicate claims and misses the DOWEC inertia value that Set B captures, Set A is preferred for having fewer factually wrong engineering claims.
